remarks: Welcome to Unit 841 in the Fountain Terrace complex! This updated 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom end-unit condo offers 875 square feet of functional living space with new floors and fresh white paint throughout. Inside, you'll find 2 spacious bedrooms, an eat-in-kitchen, ample storage space and a bright, airy atmosphere. Step out onto your private balcony and take in the breathtaking views of Downtown Stamford and the NYC Skyline. Fountain Terrace provides an array of amenities. Enjoy the convenience of on-site laundry facilities, gym, and pool. The community also features a playground, a versatile community room, and 24/7 security with a gated entrance for peace of mind. Unit 841 includes one assigned parking spot with additional parking available. The complex is pet-friendly. The HOA fee covers heat, hot water, cooking gas, water, sewer, property management, and pool service, ensuring a hassle-free living experience. This prime location offers easy access to Tully Center, bus stops, downtown, Metro-North train, I-95, shopping, restaurants, and Stamford's beaches. Don't miss the opportunity to make this exceptional condo your new home! Subject to probate approval.
